objective: Make first-use player volume safe and explicit
user_outcome: A new user can hear playback after pressing Play, and returning preferences are preserved

experience_contract.dominant_action: Play audible media with explicit controls
experience_contract.safe_default: Use a nonzero initial volume without forced autoplay
recovery_flow: Retry a failed media load without losing volume choice
truthful_claims: Do not claim playback success without observed output

recovery_and_reset: Reset test profiles only in a disposable environment

acceptance_criteria: Fresh profile starts with a visible nonzero volume
Saved zero volume remains zero for users who chose mute
critical_user_flows: Saved muted profile -> reload -> remains muted
